evidence.quote: Looking ahead, continued monetary and targeted fiscal policy support will likely be needed.
while unemployment remains quite high, the recent economic data have been encouraging and suggest that our national economy has been recovering at a rapid pace.
Asset prices in particular, remain vulnerable to significant price declines should the pandemic seriously worsen.
I anticipate that the path toward full recovery will be bumpy, and that our progress will likely be uneven.
